title: Open-plan office fire, boss stuck in the storage room

transcript.speaker: dispatcher
transcript.text: 911, what is the address of your emergency?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: 2500 Fondren Road, Piney Point offices. There are flames in the big open office on the west side, lots of black smoke.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: My boss is stuck in the storage room by the hallway, the door is jammed.
